title: SignalIncidentTopologyIntent
description: Topology resolve intent for incident-room context. The backend selects the appropriate view and default parameters; the client uses this to call topology resolve without hard-coding view choice.

viewId.description: Topology view to resolve for this incident.

scopeType.description: Optional scopeType override for topology resolve. When omitted, clients should use the incident scopeType.

scopeId.description: Optional scopeId override for topology resolve. When omitted, clients should use the incident scopeId.

params.description: Concrete view parameters to pass to topology resolve.

limits.description: Suggested resolve limits for the incident topology context.

reason.description: Optional explanation of why this topology view was selected.
